notes.title: 🚗 Big Update – Test Drive Mode is here! 🏁
notes.notes: [p]We’ve just released a new version of [i]Car Guys[/i] with a big twist: before you can hit the road against other players, you’ll need to pass a [b]fun driving test[/b] first![/p][p align="start"]Think of it as your license to compete — complete the challenge and prove your skills before joining the action.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="sCJZECxygug;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p align="start"]This is not just a tutorial… it’s a full experience designed to get you in the mood for the chaos ahead. 🎉[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]And there’s even more exciting news:[/p][p align="start"]👉 In just a few weeks, [i]Car Guys[/i] will move out of [b]Early Access[/b] and into [b]Full Release[/b]![/p][p align="start"]We couldn’t have reached this milestone without your support and feedback, and we can’t wait to share the final version with you.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Stay tuned, and in the meantime, go earn that license! 🪪🔥[/p]

notes.title: Steam Deck support
notes.notes:
After some time working with the Valve review team, we finally have a Steam Deck version. We haven’t earned the “Perfect for Steam Deck” badge yet, but you can play it without any issues.

I also want to mention that I’ve fixed a bunch of bugs and added many improvements.

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Update 0.9.5
notes.notes:
🚗 Car Guys - Patch Notes v0.9.5 🚀

Hey drivers!
I’ve been under the hood fixing bugs, tuning performance, and adding something electrifying to spice up your races…

⚡️ What’s New
	•	🔫 Turret Lasers are here!
Watch out — new turret hazards have been added to several maps. They lock on and blast laser beams at passing vehicles. Think fast, dodge faster!

🛠 Bug Fixes & Improvements
	•	Tons of bug fixes to improve stability and performance.
	•	Enhanced collisions and physics responses in certain maps.
	•	Fixes for occasional visual glitches during multiplayer races.
	•	Improved UI responsiveness and polish across menus.
	•	Better hit detection for traps and dynamic hazards.

Thanks for all your feedback during Early Access — it helps us improve every lap of the way. Keep your engines running and your feedback coming!

👉 Join the conversation on Discord and let us know what you think of the new hazards!

notes.title: Added Friends & Duels!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45460742/8744c0fea55bb9ab16630966466a6ebd63d938cc.png[/img][h1]Friend system and Duels![/h1]

Gear up for a major upgrade in Car Guys! This version introduces the all-new Friend System for the very first time—making it effortless to invite pals to the track. Now, you can easily connect with friends and challenge them to the adrenaline-pumping Duel Mode, where one-on-one races put your skills to the ultimate test.

In addition to these exciting features, performance improvements and bug fixes have been implemented to ensure a smoother, more responsive gaming experience. Update now, connect with your crew, and show off your racing prowess in Duel Mode!
